in_sanskrit.name: Rrahul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Gem of Rama
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rrahul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rrahul is a combination of the prefix 'Ra-', which is derived from the name Rama, meaning 'gem', and the suffix '-hul', which is a variant of the name Hari, meaning 'thief of hearts'. Thus, Rrahul means 'Gem of Rama, or the one who steals the hearts of people like Rama did.'
